title: Common row skeleton shared by the nine ledgers
description: Seven required fields plus two optional trace fields (03 L29-43) and the optional agent_id (proxy decision D-15). The key field is named id except in runs (run_id), scratch (ql_tag) and sessions (session_id); each ledger schema adds its own key property. schema_version is one number shared by all nine ledgers; any field-table change bumps it (03 L41).

version.description: starts at 1; a new version of the same key is a new row (03 L36)

status.description: per-ledger values; validation is keyed on it (03 L37)

session_id.description: writing session; a bare terminal records cli (03 L40)

schema_version.description: row-format version shared by all ledgers (03 L41)

force_reason.description: required when gyb writes with --force (03 L43)

via.description: marks an automatically written row: session_end (hook release rows at SessionEnd, actor = the session's role), subagent_stop (hook release rows at SubagentStop, proxy decision D-15) or reclaim (rl reclaim --apply, actor gyb) (03 L43)

agent_id.description: optional: set on rows written by a subagent (hook input agent_id); the subagent shares the parent's session_id (proxy decision D-15, verify item 5)
